title: CPU process sampling
responsibility: Reads aggregate CPU counters and a bounded process table, then returns the CPU sample with recognized process roles.

outputs.name: CpuProcessAdapter.sample
outputs.description: CPU reading with monotonic sample time, aggregate CPU counters and classified process rows.

errors.name: Unsupported CPU process platform
errors.description: sample rejects platforms other than macOS and Linux

errors.name: CPU counters unavailable
errors.description: sample rejects when the OS returns no CPU counters

errors.name: Bounded process-table command failure
errors.description: the ps process-table command can fail to launch, exceed its deadline or output cap, or be aborted
